final_message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when unset. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

The users table had no `nickname` column, so I added one with a new migration, `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`. I didn't edit 001 or 002, since those are already applied in production. The migrations README says the DBA team owns this directory, so please have them review the new file before it ships.

Changes in `src/api/users.js`:
- `createUser` takes `nickname` and stores it.
- `getUser` returns `nickname: r.nickname ?? null`, so users created before the migration read back as `null`.

I haven't committed anything.
